# Original EMF record-count controls

Generated by tools/emf_record_count_fixture.py from our original float-miter
path controls. Each image adds 12,000 alternating even/odd and winding fill-mode
records, ending in the initial mode. The visible geometry is unchanged. No
corpus artwork or third-party document engine is included. The reference
application exported native.pdf; all eight shapes were visually compared with the
browser. The fixture heading's existing font difference is outside this check.

MS-EMF 2.2.9 Header defines Records as an unsigned count, with no 10,000-record
limit. Records consume at least an eight-byte header. The reader bounds the
count by input length, then checks actual traversal against the declaration.
Existing file, geometry, frame, output and nesting limits remain. The reference application agrees;
no reference/spec divergence is claimed.

Reproduce with python tools/emf_record_count_fixture.py and the repository's
native reference export helper. Unit tests compare parsed geometry with the original
controls; browser tests compare the same visible raster and verify no-edit,
edit, unrelated package parts, undo and reopening.
